method.oracle: Independent RBJ numerator/denominator complex response; no production SVF coefficient function used.
method.impulse: 54 configurations across six sample rates, >=1.5 s zero-state responses, radix-2 FFT, 361 DC/logarithmic/Nyquist grid candidates per configuration; compare points above -80 dB.
method.sine: One-second settling followed by 40 ms sine/cosine least-squares amplitude fit; 324 center and analytically bilinear-warped half-gain points plus 72 HP/LP points.
method.ramps: Per-sample friend-state assertions for exact durations, transformed primitive ramps, exact endpoints, mid-ramp retarget and unchanged-target behavior; independent scalar output checks for 10 ms trim and bypass fades.
method.tsan: All named concurrent handoff tests in the existing and new engine suites; prepare/reset are lifecycle synchronized by contract.
